claim.claim-text: 1. A hybrid archwire for orthodontic treatment, the hybrid archwire comprising:

a first section of straight archwire comprising a continuous curvature that is configured to couple to a first plurality of orthodontic brackets having archwire slots for receiving the hybrid archwire and to move teeth corresponding to the first section using sliding mechanics, wherein the first section of archwire is configured to slide relative to the first plurality of orthodontic brackets when received in the archwire slots of the first plurality of orthodontic brackets; and two second sections disposed along distal sections of the hybrid archwire that correspond with posterior teeth of a dental arch and opposing ends of the first section, the two second sections configured to move teeth corresponding to the two second sections using non-sliding mechanics and each of the two second sections comprising a plurality of bracket-archwire sections and a plurality of interproximal loops, each of the plurality of interproximal loops disposed between adjacent bracket-archwire sections of the plurality of bracket-archwire sections, and the plurality of bracket-archwire sections configured to couple with a second plurality of orthodontic brackets to prevent sliding in a mesial and distal direction relative to the second plurality of orthodontic brackets, wherein at least one of the plurality of interproximal loops is configured to exert a force on at least one adjacent orthodontic bracket of the second plurality of orthodontic brackets.
2. The hybrid archwire of Claim 1, wherein bracket-archwire sections of the plurality of bracket-archwire sections are disposed adjacent to and on opposing ends of the first section.
3. The hybrid archwire of Claim 1, wherein the plurality of bracket-archwire sections comprises a plurality of male connectors.
4. The hybrid archwire of Claim 3, wherein the plurality of male connectors comprises a plurality of male loops.
5. The hybrid archwire of Claim 1, wherein the two second sections comprises a non-round cross-sectional shape.
6. The hybrid archwire of Claim 1, wherein the first section comprises a round cross-sectional shape.
7. The hybrid archwire of Claim 1, wherein the plurality of interproximal loops comprise bends in the hybrid archwire.
8. The hybrid archwire of Claim 1, wherein the first section corresponds to anterior teeth.
9. The hybrid archwire of Claim 1, wherein the second sections comprise a shape memory material.
10. The hybrid archwire of Claim 1, wherein the plurality of interproximal loops comprise U shapes.
11. The hybrid archwire of Claim 1, wherein the plurality of interproximal loops comprise a teardrop shape.
12. The hybrid archwire of Claim 1, wherein the plurality of interproximal loops comprise bends in the hybrid archwire.
13. The hybrid archwire of Claim 1, wherein the hybrid archwire is a single, continuous archwire.
14. The hybrid archwire of Claim 1, wherein the plurality of bracket-archwire sections are configured to be snapped into the second plurality of orthodontic brackets.
15. The hybrid archwire of Claim 1, comprising a variable cross-section.
